'''Japan Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics''' (JSIAM) is a Japanese [[non-profit organization]] for the field of [[applied mathematics]]. JSIAM is not a branch but a Japanese counterpart of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (SIAM) based in the [[United States]].
==Activities==
As same as SIAM, JSIAM publishes [[academic journal]]s in Japanese and English, hold academic conferences,<ref>The main language is Japanese, but non-Japanese speakers are allowed to submit their talk abstract and give their [[presentation]] in English.</ref> and give awards to applied mathematicians with JSIAM membership.
===English Journals and Publications from JSIAM===
* SIAM Online Magazine
* JJIAM (Japan Journal of Industrial and Applied Mathematics)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/13160|title=Japan Journal of Industrial and Applied Mathematics|website=Springer}}</ref>
* JSIAM Letters<ref>{{URL|https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/browse/jsiaml/10/0/_contents/-char/en}}</ref>
===Finance===
The finance of JSIAM is based on membership fee and support from their corporate sponsors. Their sponsors include [[Canon Inc.|Canon]], [[Nissan]], [[NEC]], [[Nippon Telegraph and Telephone|NTT]], [[Hitachi]], [[Fujitsu]] and [[Ricoh]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www2.jsiam.org/supporting_members|title=賛助会員名簿}}</ref>

EASIAM (East Asia Section of SIAM) aims to advance the studies of applied mathematics in eastern Asia. As part of the Eastern Asian community, JSIAM is partially supporting EASIAM. Within their support, EASIAM is publishing the East Asian Journal of Applied Mathematics from the Global Science Press,<ref>{{URL|http://www.global-sci.org/eajam/}}</ref> and hold the EASIAM conference every year.<ref>{{URL|http://sr3.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/easiam/conferences.html}}</ref>

===ICIAM 2023===
JSIAM has announced that they will be organizing the [[International Congress on Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] in 2023 with the [[Mathematical Society of Japan]].<ref>{{URL|http://iciam2023.jsiam.org/}}</ref>
